title: Explicit finite subset insertion into the increasing-tuple total
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f:Fin r → A, V the union of D(f_i), and J an arbitrary integer cochain complex of module sheaves on Spec A. In degree n the additive coordinate group is the product over nonempty subsets S of sections of J^(n+1-|S|) on D(product_{j∈S} f_j). For each S enumerate it increasingly, transport its section to the corresponding intersection in V, insert this into the tuple product using Pi.single, apply the inverse extension-by-zero component isomorphism in column p=|S|-1, and include this summand into the direct-sum total in degree n. Define the insertion map as the finite sum of these additive maps. These are actual constructions, and the equality of the tuple intersection with the preimage of D(product f_j) is proved from the product formula for basic opens. The definitions of the tuple total and the section restriction use [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] and [lem-sc-principal-open-cech-section-transport].

proof.text: Construct the increasing enumeration with Finset.orderEmbOfFin. Prove the basic-open product formula by finset induction and the intersection equality by membership and surjectivity of the enumeration. Compose the explicit coefficient section restriction isomorphisms, Pi.single, extendXIso inverse, and ιTotal. Sum the composites over the finite subset type. No data is chosen from an existence theorem.
